limitations.quote: //The final 0 and this 1 begin the next match
limitations.note: The patch fixed the duplicate state encoding but also reused the final 0 after a valid 1 or an invalid cycle, whereas the original FSM and the reference return to idle in both cases.

The sliding-window oracle assumed overlapping matches and retained history across invalid cycles, so the exhaustive test accepted the changed behavior instead of checking the original post-match transitions.

limitations.quote: For an overlapping sequence detector, derive each transition from the longest suffix of the matched prefix plus the new bit that is also a prefix of the target.
limitations.note: The agent applied advice specific to overlapping detectors even though this repair only required a unique match-state encoding and the reference preserved the existing post-match transitions.
